metadata.description: Local marketplace for regin's Claude Code plugins and mods. Add with: /plugin marketplace add ./regin-plugin

plugins.name: regin-agents
plugins.description: regin goal-verified skills + their subagents + the memory MCP server

plugins.name: regin-band
plugins.description: Mod: shows the regin send_to_user inbox's unread count above the prompt

plugins.name: regin-ask
plugins.description: Mod: answers AskUserQuestion from an operator's answer source (userConfig answerUrl) instead of the dialog

plugins.name: regin-bridge
plugins.description: Mod: submits the prompts regin's agent bridge delivers to this session, in place of tmux keystrokes

plugins.name: regin-attribution
plugins.description: Mod: drops the Claude-Session trailer and bare claude.ai/code/session_ links from commit and PR attribution text

plugins.name: regin-meter
plugins.description: Mod: hands rate-limit readings (session.measure) to regin, which raises one warning per window and threshold across sessions

plugins.name: regin-compact
plugins.description: Mod: keeps the session's regin feature, task and finish command in the summary when the main conversation compacts (session.compact)
